stem: A grower records a much higher PPFD map than the previous week, but the meter was held at a different canopy height and angle. What is the best interpretation?
choices: The crop definitely received more light
The comparison is weak because the measurement method changed and should be repeated using the same plane and orientation
rationale: Spatial lighting comparisons require repeatable measurement geometry. Changed sensor height or orientation can create apparent differences unrelated to actual fixture output or canopy exposure.
